overview:
A Kumaon road trip with a short trek at the end: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** Munsiyari and Khaliya Top group trip leaves Delhi in the evening. You gather at the pickup point, meet the group and travel overnight through Ranikhet and Almora towards the village of Kasar Devi.

Day 1 is in Kasar Devi, with the hilltop temple, a village walk, the cafes and sunset over the Kumaon valley. Day 2 is the drive to Munsiyari, with stops at Bageshwar, Sama Village and Birthi Waterfall. Day 3 is the trek from Balati Bend to Khaliya Top, 5 km one way, with an optional hike on to Zero Point and a night at the top. Day 4 starts with sunrise, then the trek down to Munsiyari and the drive back to Delhi. Transport, three nights of stay, 3 breakfasts, 3 dinners and a trip captain are included. Prices start at ₹9,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Delhi to Almora
itinerary.content:
Gather at the designated pickup point in Delhi by evening.
Meet your fellow travellers and begin the overnight journey towards the village of Kasar Devi, near Almora.
Overnight drive on the hill roads of Uttarakhand, passing through towns like Ranikhet and Almora.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kasar Devi | Temple and village walk
itinerary.content:
Morning: arrive and check in to your stay. Freshen up and relax after the journey.
Afternoon: visit Kasar Devi Temple, a hilltop temple.
Village walk and cafe hopping: explore the local lanes and cafes.
Watch the sunset over the Kumaon valley.
Evening: return to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kasar Devi to Munsiyari
itinerary.content:
Morning: after breakfast, begin the drive to Munsiyari.
Stop at Bageshwar, a town at the confluence of the Saryu and Gomti rivers.
Stop at Sama Village for a short halt.
Stop at Birthi Waterfall, a 126 m high fall, for photographs.
Evening: arrive in Munsiyari, check in to your stay and relax.
Dinner and overnight stay in Munsiyari.

itinerary.title: Munsiyari to Khaliya Top | Zero Point
itinerary.content:
Morning: after breakfast, begin the trek from Balati Bend to Khaliya Top.
Distance: 5 km one way. Duration: 2.5 to 3 hours.
The trail runs through pine forests and meadows.
Reach Khaliya Top and rest in forest huts or tents.
Optional hike: trek further to Zero Point for views of Panchachuli, Nanda Kot and Rajrambha.
Evening: sunset views, dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Khaliya Top to Munsiyari | Return to Delhi
itinerary.content:
Early morning: watch the sunrise over the snow-capped peaks.
After breakfast, trek down to Munsiyari.
Start the return journey to Delhi by afternoon.
Reach Delhi by late night or early morning the next day.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi in the evening for an overnight drive towards Kasar Devi, near Almora. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Munsiyari & Khaliya Top trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹9,999 per person on quad sharing, ₹10,999 on triple sharing and ₹11,999 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

Transportation from Delhi to Delhi, local sightseeing and transportation, 3 nights of accommodation, 3 breakfasts and 3 dinners, a trip captain throughout, permits, mechanical support, a first aid kit and 24x7 customer support.

faqs.q: How long is the Khaliya Top trek?
faqs.a: The trek from Balati Bend to Khaliya Top is 5 km one way and takes 2.5 to 3 hours, through pine forests and meadows. The hike further to Zero Point is optional. You trek back down to Munsiyari on Day 4.
Night 1 is in a homestay at Kasar Devi/Almora, night 2 is in a homestay at Munsiyari and night 3 is in camps at Khaliya Top.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
